correctness.rationale: The event equivalence gives an exact stationary flux polynomial. For M<=5 positive Schur transfer factors prove global and unique uniform maximization; for all M>=6 a positive Hessian follows from an exact recurrence. At M=6 all interior stationary points reduce to equal-pair configurations; convex quartic root isolation and transverse perturbation leave exactly the three permutations of the claimed optimizer. Exact symbolic and complete finite-word checks were rerun from the package. No finite experiment is treated as an infinite proof.
